summary_en: Interim dividend raised to ¥15 per share from ¥13, and year-end dividend forecast raised to ¥15 per share from ¥14, bringing full-year dividend to ¥30 per share against prior forecast of ¥27 per share.
title_en: Notice Regarding Revision of Surplus Dividend (Interim Dividend) and Year-End Dividend Forecast (Dividend Increase)
translation_en_brief:
On November 6, 2026, Nagase & Co., Ltd. announced revisions to its dividend forecasts for the fiscal year ending March 31, 2027. The interim dividend, with record date of September 30, 2026, was set at ¥15 per share, increasing from the previously forecast ¥13 per share. The year-end dividend forecast was raised to ¥15 per share from the prior forecast of ¥14 per share. This brings the total annual dividend to ¥30 per share, compared to the previous full-year forecast of ¥27 per share. Note that the company executed a 4-for-1 stock split effective April 1, 2026; prior-year figures are presented on a pre-split basis.

The company stated that enhancing shareholder value is a key management priority, and under its mid-term management plan "Walk the Talk 2028," it has positioned continuous dividend increases and opportunistic share buybacks as its shareholder return policy. The revision reflects a comprehensive assessment of current business performance trends and the level of retained earnings.
